integrated.title: CT-route generation savings
integrated.detail: output-identical: loop-request DAG-compile memos, the content-addressed lowered-model IR cache (with Weyl support), lean tree rows, native-trees export memos; CT-route parity with the site oracle not yet reached (A4 closes it)

integrated.title: EW guards, QED Catani operator
integrated.detail: typed fail-closed refusals of electroweak requests with a non-zero width or an external photon (until the complex-mass scheme and alpha(0) per photon land); the QED Catani operator summed per correction in the IR poles, equal to MadLoop's poles on the EW controls to 9.1e-13

integrated.title: LC never slower than FC
integrated.detail: LC-aware closure-block pruning in one linear pass, native tree closures with lane-run chunking and runtime AVX-512/AVX2 widths; at B = 128 LC/FC 0.42 (g g > g g g g) and 0.47 (u u~ > g g g g), full colour about 2x faster at six legs; values bitwise equal

integrated.title: Portable prepared artifacts
integrated.detail: addendum G: binary64 SymJIT -O2 plane applications for every native tree kernel and the parameter program, stored as IR and recompiled at load for the loading CPU (point_inputs native-v2); licence-free binary64; DoubleFloat and arbitrary precision under pyAmpliCol's library key; no host strings; bitwise binary64 after relocation

integrated.title: EW fermion lines
integrated.detail: W vertices along fermion flow, vertices read through their conjugate rule, lepton- and colour-singlet-rooted processes, Born closure beyond the loop orders' cap with order bounds from the model, mixed-order Born with W exchange; more than one colour-singlet fermion line refused until EWI-5

threshold_rule.label: below 5 ms: not gated (user 2026-10-24)
threshold_rule.applies: a process whose pyAmpliCol batched time per point is below 5 ms has no blocking gate: its ratio and band stay as measured and are shown, its verdict is the label, at every batch size of that configuration (B = 1 included); the batched time is the configuration's own at its largest batch above 1, and for a configuration timed at B = 1 only (the one-lane runs) the configuration on loop's; it takes precedence over a decision; the exact-rational vs binary64 input question is therefore moot and the protocol stays
